free_tier.stated: no free tier. Four paid tiers: Flash Mini 400M Credits at USD 6.99 a month, Flash Plus 1,600M at USD 9.99, Flash Pro 8,000M at USD 29, Flash Max 40,000M at USD 99. Credits convert at approximately USD 1 = 7M Credits
free_tier.notes: the allowance is denominated in Credits, and the page states the conversion.

retention.stated: monthly Credits are cleared at the end of the month and do not roll over; booster-pack Credits expire on their own 30-day cycle

interface_detail: two documented Base URLs: https://api.stepfun.ai/step_plan for the Claude Code and Anthropic SDK shape, and https://api.stepfun.ai/step_plan/v1 for OpenAI SDK Chat Completions. The page states these are client configuration URLs and not full request URLs
tooling: Claude Code, the Anthropic SDK, the OpenAI SDK, Trae, Cursor and OpenClaw are named on the page as supported clients
chaining: pairs with any Anthropic-shaped or OpenAI-shaped agent; the monthly Credit allowance is the scarce link, and it is spent by the Step Plan Base URL rather than by the standard API channel, which has its own separate quota

limits.value: no time-window or request-frequency limit; the page states Step Plan is not subject to the platform's tiered RPM and TPM limits, and usage is governed by the monthly Credit allowance of the subscribed tier
monthly Credits are cleared at the end of the month and do not roll over; the full month's Credits are issued at once on subscribing

limits_note: booster packs are available to active subscribers only and run on their own 30-day cycle: Small USD 6.99 for 400M Credits, Large USD 9.99 for 1,600M
binding_note: the monthly clearance binds before any request rate does, because there is no request rate to bind: an unused allowance is lost at month end rather than carried

identity_cost.detail: registration takes an email address with an emailed verification code, or a Google account; the platform sign-in form offers 'Continue with Google' and 'Email verification code login', and a phone number is not required. There is no free route: use needs a paid subscription, and the checkout offers 'Pay with Stripe' (credit or debit card; the Step Plan page FAQ names Visa and Mastercard, the console subscription page FAQ names Alipay, UnionPay, Visa and Mastercard, plus corporate bank transfer for enterprises) or 'Pay with balance' (the account balance, topped up by credit or debit card). Whether the checkout asks for a billing address, a country or an identity check: unverified: behind a sign-up

reliability_note: on 2026-10-30 the Step Plan page and the console subscription page showed every tier (Mini, Plus, Pro, Max) as 'Out of stock'; the vendor's notice states that Plan purchase quotas are released in limited daily batches adjusted to real-time service capacity, and that new free trials are closed. A subscription can be unavailable to buy on a given day
confidence_note: the four tiers, the Credit allowances, the conversion rate, the two Base URLs and the no-rate-limit statement are all quoted from the vendor's own documentation page, read 2026-10-22 at 200 with 9444 bytes. No subscription was bought, so the allowance is the vendor's number and not a measurement.
